auditor_value: Proof holds: speed at height h is √(u² − 2gh) = √(2gh); with 2h as the range of the mini-projectile, 2h = v² sin2α/g forces α = 45°, so vₓ = v_y = √(gh) and t = 2v_y/g = 2√(h/g).
notes: Every equation checked: 4gh − 2gh = 2gh; 2vₓv_y/g = 2h ⇒ vₓv_y = gh; (vₓ − v_y)² = 2gh − 2gh = 0; 2√(gh)/g = 2√(h/g). The mistake entry's claim reproduces: 2h/u = 2h/(2√(gh)) = √(h/g), half the correct time. The trajectory is consistent (original launch angle 60°).
